trigger.condition: MappedQuantumAdapter.Start receives falsey Conductor before Signal/Graph setup.

likelyCauses.text: The supplied Conductor argument is null/falsey at Start.

diagnostics.action: Confirm mapped Start context and Conductor presence/truthy flag only; do not inspect Conductor content.
diagnostics.expected: Conductor is falsey at line20 before setup.

correction.boundary: Conditional construction input proposal only; no graph/provider operation.

steps.action: Supply intended nonnull Conductor to authorized mapped Quantum Start; stop if owning construction context is unknown.
steps.expected: Null-Conductor guard would be false; later setup remains separate.

stopWhen: Exact message or mapped @construct context differs.
Conductor owner cannot be identified without dumping state.

verification.action: Confirm intended Conductor argument is present for Start without executing construction.
verification.expected: Local guard would be false; setup/runtime success unverified.

entries.redaction: Exclude Conductor, Signal graph, provider registration, circuit/job parameters, key, credentials and exception text; retain mapped @construct selector, exact log and argument-presence flag.
limitations: SubmitQuantumJob and registration methods have no declared activity selector.

unverified.reason: Start catch spans Signal/Jacket/Graph setup and does not identify one safe correction.
unverified.neededEvidence: Redacted failing setup operation/exception class and graph status without Conductor contents.

unverified.reportedText: Failed to register quantum provider at key: <key>; Provider <key> failed to submit circuit <name>; No quantum provider succeeded for circuit <name>
unverified.reason: RegisterQuantumProvider and SubmitQuantumJob are real methods, but mapped catalog has zero activities/concrete adapters and neither method takes a declared Activity. Variable provider/circuit failures cannot be assigned a fabricated v1 selector or safe correction.
unverified.neededEvidence: Separately authorized catalog/dispatch activity contract and structured exact emitted context/child provider origin if these methods become supported routes; no key/circuit/job values.
